column1: # games/schema.tsv: every key a tool reads from games/<id>/game.tsv. Read by games/game.py (check, query, --env).
# Columns (TAB separated): key, type, required, multi, allowed, default, readers, meaning
#   required: yes / no.   multi: one (a second row is an error) / many (a key may repeat).
#   allowed:  for enum the alternatives joined by |; for stage/other types a note; - = anything the type accepts.
# Types (the value columns after the key; "text" joins all columns):
#   text      free text, one or more columns
#   id        title id (PPSA12345, CUSA12345, ...), must equal the folder name
#   words     one or more space separated names, one column
#   relpath   path relative to the repository (no leading / or ~, no ..)
#   envrow    KEY=VALUE [when] [why]; when = - or conditions joined by , : gpu=kyty|anyps5  build=<version or eboot prefix>  scene=<name>  class=func|perf
#             and the hardware conditions hw=<machine class or chip> hw!=  gpufam=<g13..g17> gpufam!=  ram<=N ram>=N (GB)
#             cores<=N cores>=N (performance cores)  os<=N os>=N (macOS major version)
#   forbidrow KEY[=VALUE] [why]; refused from any source (profile, preset, --env), exit 78
#   cache     kind=kyplst|journal|none [dir=player] [code=ue5] [limit_mb=<n>] [app_ver=<x.y.z>]   (journal = no list: a stable per-player dir the title fills while played)
#   ue5row    decoder=<0x guest vaddr> fp=<16 hex FNV-1a 64 of the 64 bytes at it> abi=oodlelz14 (all three; needs cache code=ue5, which needs kind=kyplst dir=player)
#   addrbuild guest address (hex) [build=<version or eboot prefix>]

#   scenery   <level> <preset> src=<sha256> class=<class> drop=<len>:<hash16>[,...] [keep=<len>:<hash16>[,...]]; keep = models never removed (collision shapes); preset = reduced | minimal; names only as hashes of model-name prefixes (scripts/nps5lib/scenery.py)

#   levelfix  <level> src=<sha256> class=<class> object=<len>:<hash16> attr=<Attribute> old=<v> new=<v>; one level-file value, applied to your own copy through the overlay (default on, NPS5_LEVELFIX=0 off; scripts/nps5lib/scenery.py)
#   stage     S0..S8 (evidence per stage is checked: see game.py STAGE_EVIDENCE)
# Free keys: fact.<anything> is never read by a tool (people and the README only). Any other unknown key is an error.
# Conditional env rows: `env<TAB>KYTY_X=1<TAB>gpu=kyty,class=perf<TAB>why`. All conditions must hold (AND). Only conditions whose
#   input was given to `game.py --env` can hold: `scene=` needs --scene, `class=` needs --class; `gpu=` defaults to the profile gpu,
#   `build=` to the package build. Later rows override earlier rows for the same KEY.
# Hardware conditions (docs/reference/hardware.md): the machine comes from `--hw` (default auto = scripts/nps5lib/hw.py on this Mac, or
#   NPS5_HW); with `--hw none` or an unknown machine no hardware condition holds. `hw=m4pro-24g` is one machine class, `hw=m4pro` every
#   memory size of that chip. A VALUE may hold {gpufam}, {osbuild} and {hw}, filled from the machine (compiled-cache identities).
#   A row for hardware nobody has run says `untested` in its reason. games/hw-defaults.tsv holds the hardware rows that apply to
#   every title (after the preset, before the profile's rows).
# Never raised by any key: NPS5_SELF_MEM_LIMIT_MB above 18944 in a profile row, and above 37/48 of this Mac's RAM in a composed
#   environment (18944 on 24 GB; refused wherever it comes from).
